overview: Pragmatic stepped-wedge cluster trial of a structured decision template package (template in the board software, trained coordinator, monthly feedback to the chair) across the 11 tumour boards of a six-hospital network, following the six-wave rollout from February to December 2027.
population: Case discussions at the 11 boards from January to December 2027; each month the data manager reviews 20 discussions per board sampled by a random number list from the board's case list (about 220 a month). Patients whose discussions are sampled are invited to complete the five-item understanding questionnaire.
exposure: The template package from each board's switch-on month; boards are assigned to waves by chance within three strata of board size, at most two boards per wave, with the four boards affected by the information system merger kept out of the June to August waves.
procedures: Minutes are reviewed against the seven items by a reviewer from a different hospital who does not know the board's wave where the template layout allows; treatment dates come from hospital systems; meeting start and end times and cases per meeting from the board software; the questionnaire is offered on paper or online in four languages with help available.

outcomes.name: Complete decision documentation
outcomes.measure: All seven core decision items documented in the minutes of a sampled discussion
outcomes.why: The package's direct aim; 54 percent at baseline.

outcomes.name: Time to first treatment
outcomes.measure: Days from board discussion to first treatment for sampled discussions

outcomes.name: Patient understanding of the plan
outcomes.timing: Within four weeks of the discussion

outcomes.name: Meeting duration and cases per meeting
outcomes.measure: Minutes per meeting and cases discussed per meeting from the board software

outcomes.name: Template and feedback delivery
outcomes.measure: Proportion of discussions minuted in the template; feedback reports sent on time
outcomes.why: Separates a failed package from failed delivery.

feasibility: About 220 reviews a month fits the data manager's three days; coordinators and feedback are already funded.
biasMitigation: Wave order set by chance within size strata
Secular trend modelled with period effects
Missing periods for merging hospitals pre-specified

biasFlags.label: Secular trends
biasFlags.note: Network-wide attention to documentation may rise over 2027; handled by period effects.

biasFlags.label: Unblinded chairs and coordinators
biasFlags.note: Outcome review is done by staff from other hospitals.

biasFlags.label: Data gap for four boards
biasFlags.note: Handled by wave placement and a sensitivity analysis.

flags: One balancing and one process measure
parsimony.simplestPath: One primary outcome, stepped schedule already needed for the rollout.

theoreticalFramework: TIDieR to describe the three components of the package; no other framework.
summary: Stepped-wedge protocol with one primary outcome, two secondary outcomes, a balancing and a process measure.
